rules.q: Does a quarterback earn points for a reception?
rules.bylaws: "1 point per reception for Running Backs and Wide Receivers"; "2 points per reception for Tight Ends" (quarterbacks not listed)
rules.assumption: No. Only RB, WR and TE score receptions. The commissioner sheet gave a QB 1 point in Week 5 (Jacoby Brissett), so the two disagree.

rules.q: Does the 100-yard bonus also apply to rushing plus receiving yards combined?
rules.bylaws: Scoring: "100+ rushing yards bonus= 2 points" and "100+ yard receiving bonus= 2 points"; Format list: "100+ Rushing/Receiving Yards= 2 Points"
rules.assumption: No. Separate 100-yard bonuses for rushing and for receiving only.

rules.q: Which roster counts: the one at the first Thursday kickoff, or the final roster when the week closes?
rules.bylaws: No lock rule found. Only: "Waivers will be processed through FAAB Wednesdays through Saturdays" and "Sunday will be unrestricted to accommodate for games beginning"
rules.assumption: The roster Sleeper holds when the week closes, which already excludes pickups made after Monday night.

rules.q: Do official stat corrections made after a week closes change the result?
rules.assumption: Yes while the week is within a few days of closing; the site always uses the latest Sleeper stats and shows when they last changed.

rules.q: Do negative rushing or receiving yards subtract points?
rules.bylaws: "1 point per 10 rushing yards (.1 per yard)" (no mention of negative yardage)
rules.assumption: Yes, literally: -11 rushing yards is -1.1 points (Justin Jefferson lost 11 yards on one carry in Week 5).

rules.q: Which touchdowns count as "other" touchdowns (6 points)?
rules.bylaws: "6 points per Fumble recovery touchdown or "other" touchdown"
rules.assumption: Fumble-recovery, kick-return, punt-return and blocked-kick-return touchdowns. No Week 5 ToC player had one.

rules.q: If two teams tie for the lowest weekly score, who is demoted or eliminated?
rules.bylaws: No weekly tie-break found. The only tie-break in the bylaws is for playoff seeding: "(tie-breaker is max points for)"
rules.assumption: Not needed in Week 5 (no tie). Left open.
